 ACC Sports Boston College’s Sal Frelick, Florida State’s Shane Drohan headed to World Series
 By Greg de Deugd Published Oct. 17, 2026 | Updated Oct. 17, 2026, 1:28 pm Milwaukee Brewers right fielder Sal Frelick (10) celebrates after Game 4 of baseball's National League Championship Series between the Milwaukee Brewers and the Los Angeles Dodgers, Thursday, Oct. 15, 2026, in Los Angeles. (AP Photo/Ashley Landis) The Milwaukee Brewers are headed to the World Series, and the ACC will have a couple of familiar names along for the ride. 
 Former Boston College star Sal Frelick and former Florida State pitcher Shane Drohan are both part of Milwaukee’s postseason roster.
 Frelick played three seasons at Boston College and was named First Team All-ACC and ACC Defensive Player of the Year in 2021 before Milwaukee selected him with the 15th overall pick in the MLB Draft.
 He has since developed into a regular part of the Brewers’ lineup and outfield.
 Milwaukee Brewers pitcher Shane Drohan leaves the game during the second inning of Game 4 of baseball’s National League Championship Series between the Milwaukee Brewers and the Los Angeles Dodgers, Thursday, Oct. 15, 2026, in Los Angeles. (AP Photo/Ashley Landis) Drohan pitched at Florida State from 2018-20 before beginning his professional career. The left-hander reached the majors this season and has also been included on Milwaukee’s postseason roster.
 There is another current ACC-school connection on the Brewers. Andrew Vaughn starred at California and won the 2018 Golden Spikes Award, although he played for the Bears years before Cal joined the ACC.
 Milwaukee Brewers first baseman Andrew Vaughn (28) bats in a baseball game on Sunday, Sept. 20, 2026 in Baltimore. (AP Photo/Gail Burton) Milwaukee’s trip to the World Series gives Frelick and Drohan a chance to add a championship to careers that started in ACC baseball.
